result:
The build passes. Summary of the Phase 2 (Health/HealthKit) implementation:

- **`App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements`** (new) — adds the `com.apple.developer.healthkit` entitlement.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — adds `NSHealthShareUsageDescription` / `NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/build.xcconfig`** — links `HealthKit.framework` via `OTHER_LDFLAGS` (not linked by default in NativeScript's iOS template).
- **`app/components/Health.vue`** — wires the placeholder UI to `HKHealthStore` directly (no third-party wrapper, per spec §2): requests read/write authorization for step count, saves a 500-step sample, and loads the last 7 days via `HKStatisticsQuery` cumulative-sum queries. Status line and list refresh on every `navigatedTo`. Native completion handlers run on background threads, so all state mutations are marshalled back via `Utils.executeOnMainThread`.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — references the HealthKit ambient type declarations (excluded from the default type set) for editor/type accuracy.

Verified via `otool` and the metadata generator log that `HealthKit.framework` is actually linked into the built binary and its symbols weren't filtered out. `ns build ios` succeeds after a clean rebuild.
